Players Committee card image of [[Emperor's Orders]] (Virtual Set 15), October 2026 errata (card marked “E2”), printing: “If you did not deploy an Epic Event or Objective, deploy on table. We're Not Going To Attack?: Once per turn, may ▼ a battleground system. You may not deploy non-Imperial starships. Unless you occupy a battleground site, Dreaded Imperial Starfleet is suspended. The Alliance Will Die...: Flagship Operations does not require any Executor sites on table to deploy, and does not target squadrons. ...As Will Your Friends: At battleground systems where you have a piloted capital starship/TIE pair, Force drains = 2. During battle at a site related to a system you occupy, may add one destiny to total power and/or re-circulate.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/8eb1351/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Dark/hires/emperorsorders.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Dark/hires/emperorsorders.png] as of commit 8eb1351 “Emperors Orders errata” (9 October 2026).
